code: (()=>{clearInterval(window.__t);const uniq=[...new Set(window.__ev)].map(s=>JSON.parse(s));const casts={};for(const e of uniq)if(e.type==='ally_cast'&&!casts[e.skill])casts[e.skill]={power:e.power,cd:e.cd,reach:e.reach,half:e.halfAngle,radius:e.radius,count:e.count,cls:e.classId};const basics={};for(const e of uniq)if(e.type==='ally_basic'){(basics[e.classId]=basics[e.classId]||[]).push(e.tick);}const iv={};for(const k in basics){const t=basics[k].sort((a,b)=>a-b);const d=[];for(let i=1;i<t.length;i++)if(t[i]-t[i-1]<200)d.push(t[i]-t[i-1]);d.sort((a,b)=>a-b);iv[k]={n:d.length,mode:d[Math.floor(d.length/2)],min:d[0]};}return JSON.stringify({nSkills:Object.keys(casts).length,casts,basicIntervalTicks:iv});})()
